rationale: Add a dependency cache for the poetry install step. The workflow rebuilds the Python environment on every run across a four-version matrix with no cache, while the repository pins dependencies in poetry.lock, satisfying the dependency-cache precondition that cache inputs include a lockfile and environment. The measured P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE experiment shows adding actions/cache@v4 for dependency downloads reduced elapsed CI time while preserving all checks, so a cache step keyed on poetry.lock and python-version is inserted before poetry install. It restores the in-project venv and poetry download cache, avoiding re-download and re-install of unchanged dependencies without changing any check, test, or trigger. fail-fast is left false because required checks are not verified and full matrix diagnostics are preserved; concurrency cancel-in-progress already handles superseded runs.
